scope.positioning: RPC protoc parity covers migration-critical goctl rpc protoc flags, including runnable --zrpc_out scaffold generation, while keeping external plugin execution explicit and bounded.

compatibilityPolicy.standardProtoc: Standard protoc mode forwards include paths, go output paths, go options, and go-grpc options as argv entries without shell expansion.
compatibilityPolicy.zrpcScaffold: The --zrpc_out mode generates a runnable gofly-native gRPC project with zRPC-compatible behavior, places transport adapters under internal/api/grpc/v1/<domain>, reuses matching internal/app/<domain> application logic across HTTP and unary gRPC, preserves existing business logic files, assembles multiple primary proto files in one deterministic pass, registers every descriptor service name as a discovery alias, and intentionally does not claim goctl layout or full zRPC equivalence.
compatibilityPolicy.zrpcClientMigration: Generated RPCClientConfig maps migration-critical zRPC endpoints, target, etcd service key and cluster credentials, app/token, non-blocking mode, timeout, keepalive, and balancer settings onto gofly runtime options; generated ServiceContext initializes Config.Clients into shared named connections, creates and reuses read-only resolvers for the native zRPC etcd key layout, and closes all owned resources during shutdown; timeout covers unary and the complete server-streaming, client-streaming, and bidirectional lifecycle without treating CloseSend as completion; direct constructors may inject a resolver and app/token credentials require TLS unless insecure development mode is explicitly enabled. An explicit top-level Etcd block publishes the generated server in the same raw-endpoint layout for go-zero client discovery, with lease ownership tied to server shutdown.
compatibilityPolicy.goflyPlugin: The built-in gofly protoc plugin maps --multiple, --client=false, --module, and --name-from-filename into explicit gofly plugin options.
compatibilityPolicy.standardModeWrapperFlags: When neither --zrpc_out nor --plugin gofly is selected, --multiple, --client, and --name-from-filename are accepted with warnings and must not alter standard protoc argv or output.
compatibilityPolicy.externalPlugin: External plugin names are accepted without execution by default and are forwarded to protoc only when --allow-external-plugin is explicitly set after rejecting flag-like values, URL schemes, whitespace, control characters, and shell metacharacters.
compatibilityPolicy.timeout: Protoc execution must be bounded by an explicit timeout and return context deadline errors for hung generator processes.

rpcSurfaces.behavior: passes each include path to protoc as -I argv entries and accepts multiple proto input files for imported proto projects
forwards repeated Go and Go gRPC plugin options while suppressing conflicting default path options

generates a runnable native gRPC project from one or more primary proto files with main, configuration, service context, aggregated server registration, descriptor service discovery aliases, per-method logic, protobuf stubs, zRPC client configuration adapters, and optional client wrappers while preserving existing business logic files

aggregates multiple primary proto files, registers every service full name against the shared endpoint, and splits generated server and client adapters by domain under internal/api/grpc/v1 while sharing internal/app/<domain> application logic for --zrpc_out scaffolds; multiple=true still maps to the lower-level gofly plugin path
controls client wrapper generation for --zrpc_out scaffolds and still maps false to no_client=true for the lower-level gofly plugin path
uses the proto filename instead of the proto package for the --zrpc_out application name and remains available to the lower-level gofly plugin path
accepts external plugin names without execution by default and forwards --plugin argv only with explicit opt-in

nextPromotionCriteria: Keep external plugin execution explicit through --allow-external-plugin and reject flag-like values, URL schemes, whitespace, control characters, and shell metacharacters before passing argv entries.
Keep --multiple, --client, --module, and --name-from-filename covered by runnable --zrpc_out scaffold fixtures while preserving the lower-level --plugin gofly path.
Keep standard protoc mode free of --gofly_out and --gofly_opt unless --plugin gofly is selected.
Keep multi-proto project assembly, descriptor service discovery aliases, and zRPC configuration/client migration fixtures compiling while preserving fail-fast output conflict detection.
Do not describe RPC protoc support as full goctl parity unless every requiredFlag has implemented status and runnable oracle evidence.
